text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 'kubelet_restart_spike' on inference-pool-us-west-2 (nodes: inf-3a-12, inf-3a-14, inf-3b-07). 20 events in 5m. Autorecovery attempted.

matt (on-call): saw this. multiple nodes showing NotReady, pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Routing bumped to fallback variant for some customers.

jen (sre): FYI seeing `kernel: Out of memory` and `E cgroup: memory cgroup out of memory` in kubelet logs on inf-3a-12. Could be a memory leak in serving runtime or host-level pressure.

ops-alex: I’m looking at driver logs too — a couple of CUDA restart messages on inf-3b-07. GPU driver living-reload triggered.

matt (on-call): immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) drain non-critical inference pods to warm pool 3) scale up warm nodes in the pool + route traffic 4) consider kubelet restart if drain fails. Who can run drains?

jen (sre): I can run drains. command I’ll use:

```
kubectl cordon inf-3a-12
kubectl drain inf-3a-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

jen (sre): starting on inf-3a-12 now. watching pod evictions.

incident-bot: :page_facing_up: Pager note attached: incident id INC-20240425-2143. Alert rate -> 24 events / 6m.

matt (on-call): @dina can you push a temporary routing policy to avoid exact-node affinity for chat-infer job? we need faster eviction.

dina (eng-runtime): pushing policy change now — lowering nodeAffinity weight for chat-infer to 0 for 15m and enabling autoscale to spin up 6 warm replicas in us-west-2.

ops-alex: inf-3b-07 shows this in dmesg: `NVRM: GPU is lost` followed by driver reset. I’ll taint nodes with gpu-failed=true:NoSchedule to stop new GPU allocation.

matt (on-call): good. please also add a temporary fallback model variant (quantized) for latency-sensitive customers — less GPU memory and runs on older nodes.

dina (eng-runtime): fallback variant enabled on route `redwood-chat-latency`. traffic shifted gradually 30% -> 100% for requests hitting the affected AZ.

maya (support): heads up, we have two paying customers reporting elevated 503s and degraded latencies. CS has informed them we’re on it and routing mitigations in progress.

jen (sre): drain finished on inf-3a-12, no stuck pods. I see 4 pods failed to start on new nodes with OOM errors during init. logs:

```
2024-04-25T21:50:12Z serve-runtime[pid]: AllocationError: failed to allocate tensors: out of memory (requested 1.2G)
```

jen (sre): looks like image/container memory limit may be too low for new model variant combined with init-time preload. raising init memory limit for those deployments to 6Gi.

matt (on-call): please do that, Jen. Also document the exact patch so we can revert.

jen (sre): patch applied: updated `chat-infer` k8s deployment `resources.limits.memory` from 4Gi -> 6Gi in canary. Monitoring mem pressure now.

dina (eng-runtime): warm pool scaled + routing change complete. host-level mem pressure dropped on remaining nodes. error rate for affected routes halved.

ops-alex: I restarted kubelet on inf-3b-07 (`systemctl restart kubelet`) — node came back NotReady -> Ready after driver rebind, but GPU device registration is flaky. Keeping the taint for now.

matt (on-call): summary for pager: cause appears to be a simultaneous combination of GPU driver resets (inf-3b-07) + serving runtime init OOM on new replica allocation (init preloads). Impact: brief increase in 5xxs (~2-3% of requests in region) and latency degradation for small subset of customers. Mitigations: cordon+drain affected nodes, raised init memory limits, temporary routing to quantized variant, scaled warm pool, tainted bad GPU nodes.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident update logged: INC-20240425-2143. Mitigations applied: cordon/drain, taint gpu-failed, increased init memory, routing fallback. Customers notified: 2 enterprise customers and 14 users (CS ticket links attached).

maya (support): I'll follow up with customers in 30m with final status update.

jen (sre): monitoring for 30m. still seeing one pod restart on inf-3c-02 with minor OOM on preload; scaling warm nodes mitigated most pressure.

matt (on-call): handing off to Jen for night shift monitoring. I’ll add runbook notes and put a postmortem stub on the incidents board. if anything spikes ping @ops-alex and @dina.

jen (sre): acknowledged — taking ownership. Creating a short post-incident checklist:
- collect kubelet/journal logs for inf-3a-12 and inf-3b-07
- collect driver logs and GPU reset timeline
- correlate model rollout times with init OOMs
- verify canary revert procedure works for memory config

matt (on-call): thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :lock: Incident INC-20240425-2143 status: Mitigated -> monitoring. Escalation channel closed.

jen (sre): last message (30m later): no further restarts, error rate back to baseline. I’ll keep logs and add to postmortem draft.
